It usually clears within a day or two after a single occasion, though frequent drinking can cause longer-lasting symptoms.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScgHEIkXX3APzI9i5rbSK0djPMIPpyjyM5vPd4GMHeVZvFjHR1oE-in-zyVxBE65Do6mSaed6o-aCE2lMYtrk6OEf6Hr3X8z7ncUlVAOkMitlTSZSZ856F-83swXSQlcNmwLgsYEsgvLdu-_sJ86-pJ2R4w)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF17pimt_zcDW-hr5siIROg2JqeJX7crwRUSEou3kjMExuEyxBncRKlck5rTPtRBUqUucf8cfp9YSc93ffQPvPRDQFUtpAQ9ytUC2aOymeM7SgMYXrLVscfWwpwErsVHaoQLWBNsSy7f9YqWHPgdiqzivkCZ8rgR2mMYi2tDgpWtRj-PQIXvsmUo9tB9E)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnAEBxCJF11KzJc2vJ9P3mIzZTaBnC0jb9XEfq0PHQy9qGzhL-VKfBAmTuW4FRSqIO8k4nAfvE-8Sqfnce6FnnutcMVK_tSaC5GNqBXICoi3wov8vZfkXx01oeVBHjC1H3KMUdoet23y1VveGBgFVli5LNqgdFMFXYCx6Bw5nMGYLjXQe2oraNdac7Af0_3kjHSRZZcnOodKOXher1RA)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESzAEBxCJF1_yi8bufDRso16DGyl7SSfHvG3fm-cEDAwEKnYvpQJaHKvbtDs5KfcORC0WVD-ITB3q3F702xZHAUccaYFE8Wtv4hAyStRs3vv61ZQqRLK_q7htbRonp4lHcFT3i_02CEL9t2MraqYXWJXrljMI-vCL6pPEIhk196jR7bfqoQ299LkrC2LHL8ZJindNMVZaxFKSuJlqi5s63aJAkB7yLVn75bydDFzttEgS_gQ0jvQt72IUgBlKBxh2viaYSHV51cJuEygCB3ac)

### Common Causes

- **Dehydration and water retention:** Alcohol acts as a diuretic, increasing fluid loss. Your body may then hold onto water, causing puffiness in your abdomen, face, and hands.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESzAEBxCJF1_yi8bufDRso16DGyl7SSfHvG3fm-cEDAwEKnYvpQJaHKvbtDs5KfcORC0WVD-ITB3q3F702xZHAUccaYFE8Wtv4hAyStRs3vv61ZQqRLK_q7htbRonp4lHcFT3i_02CEL9t2MraqYXWJXrljMI-vCL6pPEIhk196jR7bfqoQ299LkrC2LHL8ZJindNMVZaxFKSuJlqi5s63aJAkB7yLVn75bydDFzttEgS_gQ0jvQt72IUgBlKBxh2viaYSHV51cJuEygCB3ac)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF17pimt_zcDW-hr5siIROg2JqeJX7crwRUSEou3kjMExuEyxBncRKlck5rTPtRBUqUucf8cfp9YSc93ffQPvPRDQFUtpAQ9ytUC2aOymeM7SgMYXrLVscfWwpwErsVHaoQLWBNsSy7f9YqWHPgdiqzivkCZ8rgR2mMYi2tDgpWtRj-PQIXvsmUo9tB9E)
- **Stomach irritation and acid:** Alcohol can irritate the stomach lining and increase acid, leading to inflammation (gastritis) or acid reflux.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXBulrBx0oHKsb9yh9GcduFTSVo6G74s4ywfGqSnc9LOHJr1NUCUbCyE2ANDbiTps59ParfAuAYHeHB-Lz0THGjDK9ONO5YAEHaTuRua22Zqw313scI9pKklChyoto9Mq1RqxGkWb705c43uXBX9Hh)
- **Slower digestion:** Alcohol can slow stomach emptying and digestive motility, leaving food and gas sitting longer.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF17pimt_zcDW-hr5siIROg2JqeJX7crwRUSEou3kjMExuEyxBncRKlck5rTPtRBUqUucf8cfp9YSc93ffQPvPRDQFUtpAQ9ytUC2aOymeM7SgMYXrLVscfWwpwErsVHaoQLWBNsSy7f9YqWHPgdiqzivkCZ8rgR2mMYi2tDgpWtRj-PQIXvsmUo9tB9E)
- **Carbonation, sugar, and salt:** Beer, sparkling wine, soda mixers, and sugary drinks add gas or feed gut bacteria that produce gas. Salty snacks and sugary mixers can also worsen water retention.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESzAEBxCJF1_yi8bufDRso16DGyl7SSfHvG3fm-cEDAwEKnYvpQJaHKvbtDs5KfcORC0WVD-ITB3q3F702xZHAUccaYFE8Wtv4hAyStRs3vv61ZQqRLK_q7htbRonp4lHcFT3i_02CEL9t2MraqYXWJXrljMI-vCL6pPEIhk196jR7bfqoQ299LkrC2LHL8ZJindNMVZaxFKSuJlqi5s63aJAkB7yLVn75bydDFzttEgS_gQ0jvQt72IUgBlKBxh2viaYSHV51cJuEygCB3ac)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF17pimt_zcDW-hr5siIROg2JqeJX7crwRUSEou3kjMExuEyxBncRKlck5rTPtRBUqUucf8cfp9YSc93ffQPvPRDQFUtpAQ9ytUC2aOymeM7SgMYXrLVscfWwpwErsVHaoQLWBNsSy7f9YqWHPgdiqzivkCZ8rgR2mMYi2tDgpWtRj-PQIXvsmUo9tB9E)

### Ways to Relieve and Prevent It

- **Drink water:** Sip water before, between, and after alcoholic drinks to help rehydrate.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXapuQEOPYcCsWRBU4iGFhlbiH4doZZL_qVybIBHYpvM697Gjrl6NiCMhnN0YTgNMEbkqwApz2F4m_kjbokIkGJ3Dp6xWe4Dpib64YOulyXQO1C8POLcdbsr9uTg32zp1-XBG0DqJ2SCk)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESzAEBxCJF1_yi8bufDRso16DGyl7SSfHvG3fm-cEDAwEKnYvpQJaHKvbtDs5KfcORC0WVD-ITB3q3F702xZHAUccaYFE8Wtv4hAyStRs3vv61ZQqRLK_q7htbRonp4lHcFT3i_02CEL9t2MraqYXWJXrljMI-vCL6pPEIhk196jR7bfqoQ299LkrC2LHL8ZJindNMVZaxFKSuJlqi5s63aJAkB7yLVn75bydDFzttEgS_gQ0jvQt72IUgBlKBxh2viaYSHV51cJuEygCB3ac)
- **Choose lower-gas, lower-sugar options:** Skip carbonated mixers and sweet drinks when possible.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXapuQEOPYcCsWRBU4iGFhlbiH4doZZL_qVybIBHYpvM697Gjrl6NiCMhnN0YTgNMEbkqwApz2F4m_kjbokIkGJ3Dp6xWe4Dpib64YOulyXQO1C8POLcdbsr9uTg32zp1-XBG0DqJ2SCk)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF17pimt_zcDW-hr5siIROg2JqeJX7crwRUSEou3kjMExuEyxBncRKlck5rTPtRBUqUucf8cfp9YSc93ffQPvPRDQFUtpAQ9ytUC2aOymeM7SgMYXrLVscfWwpwErsVHaoQLWBNsSy7f9YqWHPgdiqzivkCZ8rgR2mMYi2tDgpWtRj-PQIXvsmUo9tB9E)
- **Pace yourself and eat balanced meals:** Drinking slowly reduces swallowed air, and pairing drinks with balanced, less salty food helps slow alcohol absorption.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXapuQEOPYcCsWRBU4iGFhlbiH4doZZL_qVybIBHYpvM697Gjrl6NiCMhnN0YTgNMEbkqwApz2F4m_kjbokIkGJ3Dp6xWe4Dpib64YOulyXQO1C8POLcdbsr9uTg32zp1-XBG0DqJ2SCk)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF17pimt_zcDW-hr5siIROg2JqeJX7crwRUSEou3kjMExuEyxBncRKlck5rTPtRBUqUucf8cfp9YSc93ffQPvPRDQFUtpAQ9ytUC2aOymeM7SgMYXrLVscfWwpwErsVHaoQLWBNsSy7f9YqWHPgdiqzivkCZ8rgR2mMYi2tDgpWtRj-PQIXvsmUo9tB9E)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESzAEBxCJF1_yi8bufDRso16DGyl7SSfHvG3fm-cEDAwEKnYvpQJaHKvbtDs5KfcORC0WVD-ITB3q3F702xZHAUccaYFE8Wtv4hAyStRs3vv61ZQqRLK_q7htbRonp4lHcFT3i_02CEL9t2MraqYXWJXrljMI-vCL6pPEIhk196jR7bfqoQ299LkrC2LHL8ZJindNMVZaxFKSuJlqi5s63aJAkB7yLVn75bydDFzttEgS_gQ0jvQt72IUgBlKBxh2viaYSHV51cJuEygCB3ac)
- **Move gently:** Light activity like a short walk can support digestion and gas movement.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXapuQEOPYcCsWRBU4iGFhlbiH4doZZL_qVybIBHYpvM697Gjrl6NiCMhnN0YTgNMEbkqwApz2F4m_kjbokIkGJ3Dp6xWe4Dpib64YOulyXQO1C8POLcdbsr9uTg32zp1-XBG0DqJ2SCk)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXBulrBx0oHKsb9yh9GcduFTSVo6G74s4ywfGqSnc9LOHJr1NUCUbCyE2ANDbiTps59ParfAuAYHeHB-Lz0THGjDK9ONO5YAEHaTuRua22Zqw313scI9pKklChyoto9Mq1RqxGkWb705c43uXBX9Hh)
- **Cut back or take a break:** Reducing intake or taking time off from alcohol is the most reliable way to prevent alcohol-related bloating. According to [Healthline](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXapuQEOPYcCsWRBU4iGFhlbiH4doZZL_qVybIBHYpvM697Gjrl6NiCMhnN0YTgNMEbkqwApz2F4m_kjbokIkGJ3Dp6xWe4Dpib64YOulyXQO1C8POLcdbsr9uTg32zp1-XBG0DqJ2SCk) , cutting back—such as staying within up to two drinks a day for men or one for women—and using basic gas remedies or probiotics can also help, while [Medical News Today](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXOuFyZkicXkRE29VnqzrYTbAkJJqUL0YyKw6ElX4QBCEPXjphZAOdBjYwZMHWC_JkHMDcX4EbDdOORk50KToR1kX_GQchbrggj0rU53yCwgWv9ZpUUmQPL9m65W7-GEPYZrG7vsZN) notes antacids or acid reducers may ease acid-related discomfort.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXOuFyZkicXkRE29VnqzrYTbAkJJqUL0YyKw6ElX4QBCEPXjphZAOdBjYwZMHWC_JkHMDcX4EbDdOORk50KToR1kX_GQchbrggj0rU53yCwgWv9ZpUUmQPL9m65W7-GEPYZrG7vsZN)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXBulrBx0oHKsb9yh9GcduFTSVo6G74s4ywfGqSnc9LOHJr1NUCUbCyE2ANDbiTps59ParfAuAYHeHB-Lz0THGjDK9ONO5YAEHaTuRua22Zqw313scI9pKklChyoto9Mq1RqxGkWb705c43uXBX9Hh)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXapuQEOPYcCsWRBU4iGFhlbiH4doZZL_qVybIBHYpvM697Gjrl6NiCMhnN0YTgNMEbkqwApz2F4m_kjbokIkGJ3Dp6xWe4Dpib64YOulyXQO1C8POLcdbsr9uTg32zp1-XBG0DqJ2SCk)

There is also a consensus on [Reddit's stopdrinking community](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF1yfy-7tW6osXWr5CNLQ8aP5OaqQnLKB0jSmLpWpTBU29emdrnMqsgyKqH60PgqKGRNgbcn_PdB8330E5-RwjXz8HYmuX2Tf4gOJ1kMdHyFs8MwF9WG1qoDsUTBKD_mzz25r0EDm9XoOHk8fJiT2LuP9A79Ny90WV6onm3s5TXeeK1-tAVGaTDai1kH_wIvo) that stopping alcohol leads to less overall body inflammation and water retention in areas like the midsection, hands, and face. If you want a deeper breakdown of triggers and remedies, [Addiction Center](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXBulrBx0oHKsb9yh9GcduFTSVo6G74s4ywfGqSnc9LOHJr1NUCUbCyE2ANDbiTps59ParfAuAYHeHB-Lz0THGjDK9ONO5YAEHaTuRua22Zqw313scI9pKklChyoto9Mq1RqxGkWb705c43uXBX9Hh) covers how alcohol, mixers, and lifestyle habits contribute to bloating.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXBulrBx0oHKsb9yh9GcduFTSVo6G74s4ywfGqSnc9LOHJr1NUCUbCyE2ANDbiTps59ParfAuAYHeHB-Lz0THGjDK9ONO5YAEHaTuRua22Zqw313scI9pKklChyoto9Mq1RqxGkWb705c43uXBX9Hh)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkwEBxCJF1yfy-7tW6osXWr5CNLQ8aP5OaqQnLKB0jSmLpWpTBU29emdrnMqsgyKqH60PgqKGRNgbcn_PdB8330E5-RwjXz8HYmuX2Tf4gOJ1kMdHyFs8MwF9WG1qoDsUTBKD_mzz25r0EDm9XoOHk8fJiT2LuP9A79Ny90WV6onm3s5TXeeK1-tAVGaTDai1kH_wIvo)Are you looking into this for **occasional bloating** after a night out, or **ongoing symptoms** ? - **Choose lower-gas, lower-sugar options:** Skip carbonated mixers and sweet drinks when possible.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXapuQEOPYcCsWRBU4iGFhlbiH4doZZL_qVybIBHYpvM697Gjrl6NiCMhnN0YTgNMEbkqwApz2F4m_kjbokIkGJ3Dp6xWe4Dpib64YOulyXQO1C8POLcdbsr9uTg32zp1-XBG0DqJ2SCk)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF17pimt_zcDW-hr5siIROg2JqeJX7crwRUSEou3kjMExuEyxBncRKlck5rTPtRBUqUucf8cfp9YSc93ffQPvPRDQFUtpAQ9ytUC2aOymeM7SgMYXrLVscfWwpwErsVHaoQLWBNsSy7f9YqWHPgdiqzivkCZ8rgR2mMYi2tDgpWtRj-PQIXvsmUo9tB9E)
- **Pace yourself and eat balanced meals:** Drinking slowly reduces swallowed air, and pairing drinks with balanced, less salty food helps slow alcohol absorption.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXapuQEOPYcCsWRBU4iGFhlbiH4doZZL_qVybIBHYpvM697Gjrl6NiCMhnN0YTgNMEbkqwApz2F4m_kjbokIkGJ3Dp6xWe4Dpib64YOulyXQO1C8POLcdbsr9uTg32zp1-XBG0DqJ2SCk)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESkAEBxCJF17pimt_zcDW-hr5siIROg2JqeJX7crwRUSEou3kjMExuEyxBncRKlck5rTPtRBUqUucf8cfp9YSc93ffQPvPRDQFUtpAQ9ytUC2aOymeM7SgMYXrLVscfWwpwErsVHaoQLWBNsSy7f9YqWHPgdiqzivkCZ8rgR2mMYi2tDgpWtRj-PQIXvsmUo9tB9E)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESzAEBxCJF1_yi8bufDRso16DGyl7SSfHvG3fm-cEDAwEKnYvpQJaHKvbtDs5KfcORC0WVD-ITB3q3F702xZHAUccaYFE8Wtv4hAyStRs3vv61ZQqRLK_q7htbRonp4lHcFT3i_02CEL9t2MraqYXWJXrljMI-vCL6pPEIhk196jR7bfqoQ299LkrC2LHL8ZJindNMVZaxFKSuJlqi5s63aJAkB7yLVn75bydDFzttEgS_gQ0jvQt72IUgBlKBxh2viaYSHV51cJuEygCB3ac)
- **Move gently:** Light activity like a short walk can support digestion and gas movement.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXapuQEOPYcCsWRBU4iGFhlbiH4doZZL_qVybIBHYpvM697Gjrl6NiCMhnN0YTgNMEbkqwApz2F4m_kjbokIkGJ3Dp6xWe4Dpib64YOulyXQO1C8POLcdbsr9uTg32zp1-XBG0DqJ2SCk)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXBulrBx0oHKsb9yh9GcduFTSVo6G74s4ywfGqSnc9LOHJr1NUCUbCyE2ANDbiTps59ParfAuAYHeHB-Lz0THGjDK9ONO5YAEHaTuRua22Zqw313scI9pKklChyoto9Mq1RqxGkWb705c43uXBX9Hh)
- **Cut back or take a break:** Reducing intake or taking time off from alcohol is the most reliable way to prevent alcohol-related bloating. According to [Healthline](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXapuQEOPYcCsWRBU4iGFhlbiH4doZZL_qVybIBHYpvM697Gjrl6NiCMhnN0YTgNMEbkqwApz2F4m_kjbokIkGJ3Dp6xWe4Dpib64YOulyXQO1C8POLcdbsr9uTg32zp1-XBG0DqJ2SCk) , cutting back—such as staying within up to two drinks a day for men or one for women—and using basic gas remedies or probiotics can also help, while [Medical News Today](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXOuFyZkicXkRE29VnqzrYTbAkJJqUL0YyKw6ElX4QBCEPXjphZAOdBjYwZMHWC_JkHMDcX4EbDdOORk50KToR1kX_GQchbrggj0rU53yCwgWv9ZpUUmQPL9m65W7-GEPYZrG7vsZN) notes antacids or acid reducers may ease acid-related discomfort.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXOuFyZkicXkRE29VnqzrYTbAkJJqUL0YyKw6ElX4QBCEPXjphZAOdBjYwZMHWC_JkHMDcX4EbDdOORk50KToR1kX_GQchbrggj0rU53yCwgWv9ZpUUmQPL9m65W7-GEPYZrG7vsZN)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXBulrBx0oHKsb9yh9GcduFTSVo6G74s4ywfGqSnc9LOHJr1NUCUbCyE2ANDbiTps59ParfAuAYHeHB-Lz0THGjDK9ONO5YAEHaTuRua22Zqw313scI9pKklChyoto9Mq1RqxGkWb705c43uXBX9Hh)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXapuQEOPYcCsWRBU4iGFhlbiH4doZZL_qVybIBHYpvM697Gjrl6NiCMhnN0YTgNMEbkqwApz2F4m_kjbokIkGJ3Dp6xWe4Dpib64YOulyXQO1C8POLcdbsr9uTg32zp1-XBG0DqJ2SCk)
